description: Search PDL's Job Posting Dataset (millions of active & historical postings sourced from company career pages) with an Elasticsearch query object OR a SQL string. Beta — may require plan access (HTTP 403 if not enabled). Each returned posting costs 1 credit. API: POST /job_posting/search.

query.description: Elasticsearch query as a JSON string, e.g. {"query":{"term":{"title_role":"engineering"}}} — pass the value of "query".

scroll_token.description: Pagination token from a previous response.

size.description: Number of records to return (1-100). Default 1.

sql.description: SQL query string over the job posting dataset.

name: pdl_job_posting_search
title: Search job postings
